remarks: Welcome to 14 Ferris Avenue #9, a charming condo tucked away on a quiet street in a peaceful Norwalk community. This well-maintained unit offers a warm and inviting interior featuring beautiful hardwood floors, a bright living room with plenty of natural light, and a spacious eat-in kitchen with tiled flooring, ample cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances. Enjoy easy access to I-95, Metro-North, and public transportation, making commuting to NYC or nearby towns effortless. The area is filled with friendly neighbors, great restaurants, shopping within close distance, and offering both comfort and convenience. Recent updates include a new roof installed in April 2025, with new siding installed the end of 2025. Experience low-maintenance living in a prime location close to everything Norwalk has to offer!
